claims.claim: Verizon reported 184,000 postpaid phone net additions and 348,000 broadband net additions in Q2 2026 while mobility and broadband service revenue grew 2.8% year over year.
First-half cash flow from operations grew 9.9% and free cash flow grew 16%, supporting continued network investment and capital returns.

risks.risk: Total operating revenue declined 0.7% year over year as equipment revenue fell nearly 20%, showing headline growth remains uneven.

contradictions.contradiction: Improving service growth and subscriber additions coexist with lower total operating revenue due to equipment weakness.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of postpaid momentum into the second half and competitive promotional intensity remain to be tested.

claims.claim: Verizon forecast mobility and broadband service revenue growth to accelerate to about 4% in Q4 2026, creating a concrete second-half execution checkpoint.
The September 2026 quarterly dividend was held at $0.7075 per share, preserving capital-return continuity.

risks.risk: Acceleration to the Q4 service-revenue target depends on continued subscriber and account momentum amid intense telecom competition.

unknowns.unknown: No Q3 operating result is present here to establish progress toward the Q4 ~4% target.
